name: mnogoreels
description: Turn long videos into captioned vertical shorts, transcripts and articles with MnogoReels.
long_description: Clip YouTube, VK Video, RuTube, Dzen, Twitch, Yandex Disk and Google Drive videos into vertical Shorts/Reels with captions and hooks, get transcripts, articles and B-roll, and follow job progress. Requires a MnogoReels account and an API key from https://mnogo-reels.ru/dashboard/developers?tab=keys. Paid tools always quote the price and need your confirmation.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Checks whether the configured MnogoReels API key works and shows this server's settings.

tools.name: get_options_guide
tools.description: Explains the option values accepted by create_clip_job and recut_clip_job: video modes, clip lengths, caption styles, hook styles, story arc styles, outros, framing and languages, plus the pricing rules and the 30-minute limit per job.

tools.name: check_video_source
tools.description: Checks whether MnogoReels can download a video link and returns its title, length and platform.

tools.name: quote_clip_job
tools.description: Calculates the credit cost of create_clip_job or recut_clip_job without spending anything, and checks that MnogoReels can download the video.

tools.name: create_clip_job
tools.description: Starts AI clipping of a long video into vertical 9:16 short clips with burned-in captions and a hook title, plus optional cold-open hooks, music and B-roll.

tools.name: get_clip_job
tools.description: Returns the status, progress and results of a clip job created by create_clip_job, recut_clip_job or on the MnogoReels website.

tools.name: list_clip_jobs
tools.description: Lists the user's clip jobs, newest first, including jobs started on the MnogoReels website.

tools.name: recut_clip_job
tools.description: Creates a new clip job from the same source video as an existing job, with different settings such as caption style, hook style, clip length, language, framing, music, B-roll or prompt.

tools.name: retry_clip_job
tools.description: Re-runs a failed clip job with the same settings, free of charge, keeping the same job_id.

tools.name: create_transcription
tools.description: Starts a timed speech-to-text transcription of a video or audio link.

tools.name: get_transcription
tools.description: Returns the status and text of a transcription started with create_transcription.

tools.name: create_article
tools.description: Turns the source video of a completed clip job into a long-form article: title, SEO title and description, summary, sections, key takeaways, chapters with timestamps, up to 4 frames from the video as illustrations, and the full timed transcript.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Returns an article created with create_article as Markdown, with its status.

tools.name: get_broll_asset
tools.description: Returns one B-roll item by asset_id with fresh links.

tools.name: list_packs
tools.description: Lists the user's publication packs, newest first.

tools.name: get_pack
tools.description: Returns one publication pack: suggested titles, descriptions, cover texts and hashtags, thumbnail images, teaser videos, the article id and the clip job id.

tools.name: create_youtube_thumbnails
tools.description: Generates 1 to 4 AI YouTube thumbnail images (1280×720 JPEG) for a video, using frames from the video plus an optional title and art direction.

tools.name: get_youtube_thumbnails
tools.description: Returns the status and images of a thumbnail job started with create_youtube_thumbnails.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Hide tools that create jobs or spend credits
